profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a versatile software engineer with over 10 years of experience spanning full-stack, desktop, embedded, and mobile application development. Passionate about taking ideas from concept to reality, I excel at designing and delivering innovative solutions while continuously seeking opportunities to learn and grow further in my career.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of the Field Support Platform (FSP), an internal enterprise platform built with Node.js, Express.js, and EJS, unifying order, subscription, and IoT device lifecycle management across e-commerce, payment, ERP, and CRM systems

• Built a REST API integration layer (OpenAPI) connecting the webstore, internal backend services, and external systems including OrderCloud, Stripe, USPS, SAP, and Salesforce – enveloping 6 disconnected tools under a single unified workflow

• Implemented OAuth-based authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) using AWS Cognito and DynamoDB, with permissions enforced at the controller level and configurable at runtime – enabling fine-grained, role-specific access control across the platform

• Developed end-to-end order management capabilities, enabling operations and customer support teams to manage customer orders, process cancellations, returns, and refunds – supporting 800+ orders processed through the platform since Q4 2025

• Built subscription management features syncing internal backend records (user-device mapping) with
OrderCloud billing records, enabling teams to manage memberships, upgrades, cancellations, and account provisioning

• Served as technical lead, driving architectural decisions and cross-functional feature planning with engineering, operations, and customer support teams — while mentoring engineers through the project lifecycle

positions.title: Senior Software Application Engineer
positions.description:
-- Stafl Fleet --
Led the development of a cloud-based Fleet Management System to collect, monitor, and display telemetry data collected by IoT-connected devices.

• Built with React.js and Node.js, leveraging AWS services (Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, Timestream, S3) to enable real-time monitoring, historical data review, and efficient fleet management
• Architected and improved system design to ingest large volumes of telemetry data, optimizing storage and query performance for efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Achieved a 50% cost reduction and 30% performance improvement by leveraging AWS services, including Lambda, ElastiCache, Timestream, DynamoDB, and S3
• Designed custom MQTT Topic and Payload protocols to effectively communicate telemetry data and commands between a fleet of IoT-connected devices and fleet command

-- Stafl TCU --
Developed an IoT-enabled telematics embedded device using ESP32 with FreeRTOS to collect and transmit telemetry data to Stafl Fleet.

• Integrated Telit Modem and Hologram SIM for cellular communication and u-blox GPS for geo-location and datetime precision
• Implemented CANBus for real-time data acquisition and communication
• Utilized HTTPS and MQTT protocols for secure, efficient data transmission to Stafl Fleet
• Implemented full data logging feature to externally store telemetry data for offloading and analysis
• Enabled internal and external Firmware OTA updates for remote device management and maintenance

-- Stafl Configuration Management Web App --
Developed a configuration management system to enable engineers, operations to create and release parts for product development, using Django, Bootstrap, and AWS

• Utilizing dashboard UI design, users are able to create, view, edit Parts designated for product development
• Integrated Microsoft Sharepoint API to allow engineers to create, package, and release design files and documents into Sharepoint

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-- Genovation GXE Infotainment System --
Led the development and integration of an infotainment system for an all-electric supercar, enabling the display and control of vehicle performance, battery metrics, and comfort features using C# with Mono on an embedded Linux OS, featuring Crank Storyboard UI for the frontend interface.

• Integrated telematic features to remotely monitor and track vehicle location and performance and to perform firmware OTA updates to both internal hardware and external components including the VCU, BMS boards

-- AER Cordless Hair Dryer --
Developed the Bluetooth LE functionality for a cordless hair dryer product to monitor hair dryer's performance and to assist with firmware updates, using Si-Labs, STM32 MCUs. Created companion Android App to monitor, and debug the hair dryer's performance and to perform firmware updates,

-- Inventory Management System --
Created a Inventory Management System using Django, Bootstrap, DataTables, and MySQL to manage the inventory, orders, and movement of BMS and related products. 

• Designed and developed robust APIs to support product assembly software to monitor and assist the movements during manufacturing
• Developed advanced views and tools to enhance UX and operational efficiency, including part BOM generation, cost analysis views, dynamic serial label creator

-- Battery Testing Software --
Developed HMI apps using WPF to perform and visualize battery, cell tests as they go through various test conditions to generate critical performance data.

• Implemented CANBus to communicate with BMS and related components, enabling real-time analysis, performance control, and fault parsing

-- Automated Board Checkout Program --
Developed board checkout program using WPF, UART, and HTTPS to automate the board checkout process of BMS and related products by automating the firmware flashing, testing, and serialization.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed on microcontrollers that interfaces modules such as a CMOS camera, GLCD displays to prototype a device-unique QR decrypter device

Developed a Pebble smartwatch app that decrypts encrypted messages sent from a web mail client, utilizing bluetooth communication between a computer and watch; or SMS messages sent from a private messenger app.

Developed an Android app that encrypts messages using our public-key cryptography library; communicates to a central server, passes messages through SMS, where messages are decrypted either through the phone or Pebble watch.

Designed web security software with Javascript (jQuery) and CSS.

Wrote automation scripts (Python, PhantomJS) for security testing.

honors.title: AeroBerry - Highest Potential
honors.description: Won Highest Potential in the Senior Design Competition hosted by the Jack Baskin School of Engineering (University of California, Santa Cruz).
honors.issuer: Issued by Baskin Alumni Advisory Council on behalf of the Jack Baskin School of Engineering · Jun 2013

projects.title: Advanced Analog Integrated Circuits Final Project
projects.description: Design a folded-cascode op-amp with common-mode feedback using MOSFETs meeting certain design criteria using Cadence Schematic capture. Simulated using Pspice. Tweaked design to get the best performance using different methods of CM feedback, transistor sizes, setting bias voltages/currents

projects.title: AeroBerry
projects.description: The project combines a Raspberry Pi with an AeroQuad frame, giving the name "AeroBerry". It is an autonomous quadcopter with an infrared tracking camera system. Software running on the Raspberry Pi recognizes, tracks, and follows an infrared beacon. Technical challenges include customizing the firmware on the AeroQuad32 microcontroller to communicate with the Raspberry Pi, mounting multiple camera systems on a pan-tilt system, designing a lithium polymer battery power supply capable of distributing enough power to each different applications and within a capable flight time.
